content: In this work, we propose DAS, a novel framework that jointly performs feature adaptation and semi-supervised learning. We have demonstrated through multiple experiments that DAS can better leverage unlabeled data, and achieve substantial improvements over baseline methods. We have also shown that feature adaptation is an essential component, without which, semi-supervised learning is not able to function properly. The proposed framework could be potentially adapted to other domain adaptation tasks, which is the focus of our future studies.
